Deel (Deel, Inc., formerly Skypher, Delaware) is a global HR and payroll platform. No numeric platform uptime SLA was confirmed from publicly accessible documents. Deel's "99.9% payroll accuracy" is a payroll data quality metric, not a platform uptime commitment. Enterprise customers should review the Trust Center SLA document at trust.deel.com or request terms during MSA negotiation.
